page.layout: One block of running text, full width, with a centred running head above it. No margin notes, no catchword. The gathering signature "C 5" stands at the lower right.

main_text.l: Cauda cometæ aliàs rarior est: quando globus
pb materiæ puritatem fortiùs compactus, minùs
fumi æquabiliter circumfusi, formâ crinium ca-
pitis, emittit: unde Crinitus Cometa. Aliàs den-
sior in modum barbæ,
dum globus ardens ob
materiæ impuritatem levius compactus multùm
fumi emittit: unde Barbatus appellatus est Co-
meta.
Cometa porrò semper fere apparet sub lacteo
circulo: eo maximè tempore, quo aliquis ex tri-
bus planetis superioribus cum alio planeta syno
dicè conjunctus, magnam virtutè obtinet ejus-
modi materiam viscosam copiosè extrahêdi atqj
gubernandi: adjuvante præsertim eclipsi Solis
aut Lunæ, vel retrogradatione Mercurii.
Inde nâqj Cometa, ab eo Planeta, à quo præ-
cipuè procreatus est & gubernatur, denominatur
ejusqj colorem quodammodo refert: ac crescète
per aliarum stellarum irradiationem virtute Pla-
netæ, Cometa quoqj augetur ac crescit, illiusqj
motum fere imitatur; decrescente, & ipse sen-
sim decrescit corpore, atqj irregularius movetur.
Ita alius cometa est Saturninus, alius Jovialis, alius
Alia meteora ignita simpliciain[?] suprema aeris
regione, sunt flammæ: vel Continuæ, vel discontinuæ.
Flammæ continuæ sunt, cùm Ignis perpendicularis,
& Candela ardens: tum Bolis sive jaculum ardens.

page.notes: The top right corner has a small mark (possibly a printed page mark or a damaged figure) that I could not read, so I have not recorded a page number. The bottom right shows the signature C 5. A faint stamp at the very bottom edge and show-through from the other side are left out. "simpliciain" is a doubtful split of "simplicia in": the printed word is unclear. "pb" in the first paragraph is printed as shown and is probably a printing error for "ob", which the second occurrence in the same paragraph confirms.
